description: This file contains utility functions and constants for end-to-end testing of the Notesnook web application, including note creation, editing, file download/upload, and session management.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Type defining the structure of a note with title and optional content.

classes.name: AppModel
classes.description: Imported class representing the application model used for navigation and interactions in tests.

methods.name: getTestId
methods.description: Generates a selector string for test IDs with optional variant.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note in the application using the provided page and note data.

methods.name: editNote
methods.description: Edits the note's title and content within the page, with optional delay.

methods.name: downloadAndReadFile
methods.description: Handles file download via a page action, reads the file content, and cleans up temporary files.

methods.name: uploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a file to the page using a file chooser triggered by an action.

methods.name: isTestAll
methods.description: Checks if the environment variable TEST_ALL is set to true.

methods.name: createHistorySession
methods.description: Sets up a test session with note editing and locking, returning session details.
